reason: I already pay for a booking engine and a channel manager, and they already give me a booking page on my own site. A studio asking $800 for a 'concept' that plugs into the same tools feels like paying twice for one thing. I would need to see that my current setup cannot do this before I spend anything.
objection: The page they show is the same kind of thing SiteMinder or Cloudbeds already gives me, so what exactly am I buying for $800? And I still need Booking.com for new guests, so the saving depends on how many people actually come back to my site, which I do not know yet.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from my own booking engine that it cannot take a deposit and send the day-before reminder, plus a free look at my real commission numbers from last season that shows the saving is real.
